enableThermostat.title: Enable Thermostat
enableThermostat.description: Expose sauna heater as a HomeKit HeaterCooler accessory

enableLight.title: Enable Light Switch
enableLight.description: Expose sauna light as a HomeKit Switch

enableFan.title: Enable Fan Switch
enableFan.description: Expose sauna fan as a HomeKit Switch

enableSteamer.title: Enable Steamer Switch
enableSteamer.description: Expose steamer as a HomeKit Switch — disable if your sauna has no steamer

enableDoorSensor.title: Enable Door Sensor
enableDoorSensor.description: Expose sauna door state as a HomeKit Contact Sensor — requires a Fenix panel with a door sensor (e.g. FX002XW)

enableExternalSensor.title: Enable External Sensor
enableExternalSensor.description: Expose a paired satellite sensor (e.g. SAM001W) as Temperature/Humidity accessories — only applies if one is paired to your MyHarvia 2 account
